response.justification: The candidate lacks the required 8 years of C++ experience and has no demonstrable background in large-scale cloud compute infrastructure, distributed systems, or technical leadership in cloud platforms — instead, their experience centers on web, mobile, and open-source tools using TypeScript, DLang, and Node.js, with minimal alignment to the job's core technical requirements.
strengths: Strong full-stack versatility across multiple languages and domains
Proven track record in open-source contributions and community mentoring
Experience with CI/CD, testing frameworks, and dev-ops infrastructure setup
concerns: Only minimal C++ exposure (limited to academic/bachelor thesis), far below 8-year requirement
No evidence of cloud compute platform design, distributed systems, or hardware architecture experience
Lacks documented technical leadership in cloud/DevOps engineering or large-scale infrastructure ownership
